Chapter 1339: 19: Twenty Years

Chapter 1339: Chapter 19: Twenty Years

Entering Dao practitioners, their spirits harmonizing with heaven and earth, can achieve feats far beyond ordinary human perception.

For instance, standing there, yet not being seen by others, using Spiritual Power to create illusions to deceive enemies.

This method purely utilizes Spiritual Power, and the sheer might is not significant.

Furthermore, practitioners use Spiritual Power to harness the power of heaven and earth, which is their most formidable means of attack.

Enough to make ordinary martial artists despair.

Don’t be fooled by their cautious demeanor in front of the Da Feng Dynasty.

Aside from such peak dynasties, there are almost none in the world that can make practitioners fear.

During its heyday, the Red Lotus Sect had only a little over ten practitioners.

Even so, they stirred up storms across several states.

As for those Dao Masters and Heavenly Masters, they are truly beyond comparison.

When reaching the level of a Dao Master, they have no interest in participating in rebellion.

All a Dao Master needs is to pledge allegiance to the Da Feng Dynasty to receive benefits and treatment.

Almost equals the rank of a prince.

If unwilling to pledge allegiance to Da Feng.

They can completely escape to some small countries surrounding Da Feng.

With the power of a Dao Master, they absolutely reign supreme in those small countries.

Opposing the Da Feng Dynasty? Dao Masters are no fools.

…

Of course, becoming a practitioner.

Is exceptionally difficult.

Da Feng Dynasty offers unified training, resources, guidance all of the highest quality.

Yet, the number of practitioners they can cultivate is extremely low.

Even fewer in the civilian world.

Seeing Lin Yuan’s spirit drawing upon heaven and earth, the hunchbacked old man knew this is a sign of becoming a practitioner.

The excitement in his heart was palpable.

Lin Yuan becoming a practitioner, his ability to survive against the court’s pursuit naturally greatly enhanced.

Plus, having himself, a peak martial artist.

As long as they do not willingly enter certain desperate situations.

There should be little concern for their lives.

The Red Lotus Sect Leader faced court extermination, ending in death.

Because of his flamboyance, combined with being long noticed by Da Feng’s Tao Suppression Department.

But Lin Yuan is different.

The outside world is unaware that Lin Yuan has become a practitioner.

The pursuit force is surely not strong.

“Calm down, calm down.”

“The most important thing now is safeguarding the young master’s path.”

The hunchbacked old man forced himself to calm down.

Although he is not a practitioner, he knows some taboos among them.

Such as when a practitioner first draws upon heaven and earth, their mind must remain undisturbed.

To not be torn apart by the violent power of heaven and earth.

Thinking of this, the hunchbacked old man became even more vigilant.

…

What the hunchbacked old man does not know.

Even a Dao Master must cautiously control the power of heaven and earth.

In front of Lin Yuan, they behave obediently like a cat.

Given Lin Yuan’s realm, even if all methods are suppressed.

Controlling mere power of heaven and earth is still a piece of cake.

In terms of mastery over the power of heaven and earth.

Not to mention Dao Masters, even Heavenly Masters, fall far behind him.

“The improvement is too little.”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, with heaven and earth force gradually calming down all around him.

Entering Dao for the first time, drawing the force of heaven and earth into the body, is the moment of greatest improvement.

Yet this greatest improvement left Lin Yuan quite unsatisfied.

Especially regarding the physical body.

At most, slightly stronger than before entering Dao.

Even Heavenly Masters still possess ordinary mortal bodies.

This cyclical world imposes heavy suppression on the physical body, with only a bit of leniency regarding Spiritual Power.

Yet without a strong physique, it cannot nurture powerful mental will.

For most cultivators.

The physical body is the foundation.

The physical body nurtures everything, the birth of various extraordinary powers.

“At least some capability for self-preservation is acquired.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly, with his current use of Spiritual Power, he assumes he can directly rival Dao Masters.

A Dao Master, unless foolishly confronting the court head-on.

Elsewhere, they would live very freely.

The court would not overly compel a Dao Master.

Take for example the Red Lotus Sect facing court siege.

If the Red Lotus Sect had possessed a Dao Master.

The court’s attitude might not have been this way.

There would be some chance of consideration for drawing them in.

As for the nature of Red Lotus Sect’s rebellion?

Isn’t whether or not to rebel decided by the Da Feng Dynasty?

…

As the power of heaven and earth settled into complete calm.

The hunchbacked old man carefully approached.

“Third Uncle.”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, nodding slightly to the hunchbacked old man.

In the thousands of future timelines he had just observed.

The hunchbacked old man, Third Uncle, demonstrated absolute loyalty, sacrificing himself multiple times to provide Lin Yuan chances to escape.

“Young master, did you, have you become a practitioner?”

The hunchbacked old man spoke with excitement, although he had long deduced this from the changes in the power of heaven and earth, he still wanted to hear Lin Yuan confirm it personally.

“Upon hearing of father’s death, my thoughts fluctuated and I luckily entered Dao.”

Lin Yuan casually found a reason.

Entering Dao in this world is a profoundly mysterious affair.

Besides personal accumulation and talent, it is also somewhat related to the external environment.

Stimuli, impacts, and more all influence it.

“Good, good, good.”

The hunchbacked old man nodded repeatedly.

Not knowing whether he was happy or pained.

Happy because Lin Yuan became a practitioner.

Pained due to losing his father and being pursued like this by the court.

“Young master, we shall depart now for Yong State, leveraging its branch sect, there might be a chance to rise again.”

The hunchbacked old man glanced at the sky, gradually darkening.

If it were daytime, there would be too many court spies, even deep in the mountains they dare not travel.

Only when night falls.

Using the cover of darkness.
